messages:
amy: Noticed fncall validation spikes on /billing.apply (route=billing_v1). metric shows validation.fail up 3x last hour. Anyone see root cause?
diego: Looking into it. Adapter seems to send items as array in some cases and object with numeric keys in others, validator flags object_vs_array mismatch.
nora: We should emit fncall.validation.reason with low-cardinality enum (enum_mismatch, missing_field, object_array_conflict, type_mismatch) and a sampled trace_id for debugging.
amy: Also need billing attribution when we soft-fallback. If soft-fallback routes to degen, split tokens_charged into primary/fallback tags so usage reports are accurate.
diego: Implementation plan: runtime emits reason + action tag (reject|soft_fallback|auto_fix) and metric sample_rate default 0.01. Traces store redacted payloads (redact card_number,email,ssn).
nora: Console UX: add per-route soft-fallback toggle OFF/SOFT/STRICT and a per-customer cap with auto-revert when cap exceeded. Show estimated cost delta.
deploy-bot: canary fncall-telemetry v1 deployed to 3 hosts :white_check_mark:
amy: I'll own dashboard panels + alert thresholds. Diego to PR runtime change. Nora to mock console toggle copy.
diego: PR incoming, will include unit tests and a note about retaining traces 24h only unless legal approves.
amy: Thanks. Ping here if validation.fail increases after canary. :eyes:
